name: @w6w-apps/tidycal
description: Read and manage TidyCal scheduling: bookings, booking types, available timeslots, contacts and teams.

w6w.longDescription:
TidyCal is a scheduling tool — publish booking types, let people pick from your live availability, and get a booking with a contact attached — and this app covers that flow over TidyCal's own REST API.

It lists booking types and their open timeslots, creates and cancels bookings, manages contacts, and covers TidyCal's team features — team bookings, team booking types, and adding or removing team members. Reading real availability before booking means a workflow never has to reproduce TidyCal's own scheduling logic, such as calendar conflicts, padding and minimum notice, itself.

Good for booking a call automatically once a lead reaches a certain stage elsewhere, canceling a booking when an external event says the meeting is no longer needed, syncing new bookings and contacts into a CRM, and coordinating team scheduling across a shared calendar link.
